{"path":"snake_anthropic-claude-opus-5-5_01.html","edit_description":"Create a complete single-file Snake game (HTML+CSS+JS, no external deps). Requirements:
- Canvas 30x30 grid (e.g. 20px cells = 600x600), dark styled page, centered.
- Start menu overlay with 3 modes: Human vs Human, CPU vs Human, CPU vs CPU (buttons + keys 1/2/3). Show controls: Player 1 (green) WASD, Player 2 (blue) Arrow keys. In CPU vs Human, the human is arrow keys, CPU is the other snake.
- Two snakes start at opposite sides moving toward center, continuous movement on a tick (~100ms). Direction queue per snake preventing 180° reversal.
- Single shared food (maybe 2 food items); eating grows snake by 1 and +1 score, food respawns on free cell.
- Collision: wall, own body, other snake's body => that snake dies. Head-on collision => both die. Game ends when any snake dies; winner is the survivor (or draw if both die; if both die same tick compare scores? just call draw). 
- CPU AI: BFS shortest path from head to nearest food avoiding snake bodies (treat tails as moving optional); if no path, choose safe move maximizing reachable area via flood fill; avoid cells adjacent to opponent head when possible.
- HUD above canvas showing both scores with labels (P1/P2 or CPU) and current mode, updated live.
- Game over overlay: shows result (who won / draw, reason), final scores, "Press R or Space to restart, M/Esc for menu". Restart with same mode on R/Space/Enter.
- P key pause optional.
- Draw grid subtly, snakes with head distinguishable (eyes), food red circles."}
